question: What are the two main categories of computer maintenance?
explanation: Maintenance is broadly split into caring for the physical parts and looking after the digital programs. [learn more](BMP123_U1_T4#BMP123_U1_T4_h1)

question: Why is regular computer maintenance important in a healthcare setting?

options.A: It prevents sudden system failures that disrupt patient records
options.C: It eliminates the need for electricity backups
options.D: It replaces broken medical diagnostic equipment

explanation: Keeping computers running smoothly ensures uninterrupted access to patient data and daily hospital workflows. [learn more](BMP123_U1_T4#BMP123_U1_T4_h1)

question: Which of the following is a primary enemy of computer internal components?
explanation: Accumulated dust traps heat inside the computer case, which can damage sensitive electronic chips. [learn more](BMP123_U1_T4#BMP123_U1_T4_h2)

question: What tool should you safely use to blow out dust from inside a PC case?
explanation: Compressed air delivers a dry, controlled stream of air that safely dislodges dust without introducing moisture. [learn more](BMP123_U1_T4#BMP123_U1_T4_h2)

question: Which built-in utility helps you check for frozen programs and high processor usage?
explanation: Task Manager displays all currently running applications and shows how much memory and processing power each one uses. [learn more](BMP123_U1_T4#BMP123_U1_T4_h3)

question: Why is it important to write down exact error codes when a computer crashes?

options.A: They point directly to the specific cause or failing component
options.B: They serve as a password backup
options.C: They speed up internet connection rates

explanation: Error codes provide precise technical clues that help technicians identify whether the issue is hardware or software related. [learn more](BMP123_U1_T4#BMP123_U1_T4_h3)

question: What is the very first thing you should check when a computer refuses to turn on?
explanation: Always verify power cables and socket connections before suspecting expensive internal hardware failures. [learn more](BMP123_U1_T4#BMP123_U1_T4_h4)

question: A computer starts up with a strange series of short audio beeps and shows no display on the screen. What part of the system is likely signaling an error?
explanation: Motherboards emit specific beep codes during startup to alert the user when vital hardware like RAM or graphics cards fail to initialize. [learn more](BMP123_U1_T4#BMP123_U1_T4_h4)

question: How do background startup programs affect overall computer performance?

options.A: They protect the computer from power surges
options.B: They increase the storage capacity of the hard drive
options.C: They automatically clean out accumulated dust
options.D: They consume processing power and slow down daily operations

explanation: Programs that launch automatically upon startup continue running in the background, using up valuable memory and processor cycles. [learn more](BMP123_U1_T4#BMP123_U1_T4_h5)

question: Which of the following practices serves as the ultimate safety net against sudden hardware failure?
explanation: Backing up your files ensures that even if a computer permanently crashes, your important documents and records are not lost. [learn more](BMP123_U1_T4#BMP123_U1_T4_h5)
